City of Santa Claus, Georgia

Amendment to Existing Ordinance To be amended: Section 6 — Business License Rates - 2023

Purpose: To protect and conserve value of property and property owners located within the commercial zones in C-1 and C-2 zones.
1:
“Any person wishing to establish a business and\or purchase a license must first present their request to the City of Santa Claus Council and receive their approval before proceeding with either opening or establishing a business within the city limits of Santa Claus, Georgia.

Be it further ordained by the Mayor and Council that all ordinances in conflict with this ordinance are and the same is hereby repealed and becomes effective on the first day of March, 2024.

Adopted by unanimous consent of the Council on the first reading, all members being present and ordered posted at the City Hall, and the City website.
